title: Applied-Energistics-2 issue #8983: Duplicate MenuType registration crash in InitMenuTypes.registerAll (AE2 19.2.17, NeoForge 1.21.1) — reproduces with all addons disabled

text:
[issue by JFloresAranda]
### Describe the bug

As i have grown to enjoy a lot this mod an its addons, the pack im developing wouldnt be an exception. However i disabled all of them and the game would still crash. I disabled Ae2 and the game starts. 

AE2 throws `java.lang.IllegalStateException: Adding duplicate value 
'net.minecraft.world.inventory.MenuType@...' to registry` during its own 
`RegisterEvent` handling, which causes a `ModLoadingException` 
("Failed to register some entries") during game startup. The crash happens 
consistently, in the same place, in `InitMenuTypes.registerAll` 
(InitMenuTypes.java:118), called from `InitMenuTypes.init` (line 71), 
called from `AppEngBase.lambda$new$0` (AppEngBase.java:154).


### How to reproduce the bug

Start the game

### Expected behavior

Crash occurs during `RegisterEvent` dispatch for modid `ae2`.

### Additional details

Im working in a modpack of my own, and im using a lot of mods. Perhaps there is a mod/addon with an incompatibility issue, however the game started normally when i disabled Ae2. 

### Which minecraft version are you using?

1.21

### On which mod loaders does it happen?

NeoForge

First of all, im working in a modpack, so im experimenting with a lot of mods. Doing that, I wanted to try Mine colonies and some addons of it, It start crashing. My crashes guided me to Ae2, but with all the support the mod gets, It is really weird, that it would fail in something like this and it wouldnt be patched immediatly. At the end it was a compatibility addon of MineColonies. In my case this was the addon: https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/minecolonies-compatibility. 
Take into account, that for your case fellas, it could be an entirely different mod thats causing this. Not necesarily this one.
